messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a zipstream quiet window for the private installer (v1.4.2-zipstream). Target window Thu 2026-03-05 03:00-04:00 UTC. Need final packaging pin, explicit rollback criteria, and who will ack deploybot manual gate?

jessie: Packaging status: shrinkwrap zipstream built locally, tag: private-installer:v1.4.2-zipstream-rc3
jessie: checksum (short): sha256:8f3b2a7c...f9a1

deploybot: [deploybot] canary started on staging at 03:10 UTC. push -> registry succeeded. build link: https://ci.internal/reports/zipstream/rc3

sam: infra note: staging canary looks fine for CPU and mem. Offsite mirror upload had a transient timeout on first push (mirror-3). Retrying with backoff.

maria: SRE input: define rollback triggers now. My recommendation: immediate abort+rollback if we see mirror transfer errors during fanout OR if canary P50 latency >200ms across 3+ canary nodes for 2 consecutive minutes. Also auto-abort if deploybot reports >5% failed replicas in preflight.

alex: Agreed. Locking rollback triggers: mirror-transfer-error OR canary-latency>200ms (persisting) OR preflight-failures>5%. Also we will pin the installer manifest epoch to the start of window: 2026-03-05T03:00Z.

jessie: On it — updating packager to hard-pin manifest and re-signing submanifest. Command I'm running:
```
./packager --manifest-manual-pin 20260305T0300 --signer=corp-signer --out=private-installer:v1.4.2-zipstream-rc3
```

luke: Quick ops question: we'll require PKG + INFRA + SRE ack before deploybot will proceed from canary->fanout, right? Need that manual approval gate enabled.

alex: Yes — enable manual approval gate. deploybot will comment when canary checks complete and wait for three :thumbsup: reactions from the approvers list (jessie, sam, maria).

deploybot: [deploybot] Manual approval required: canary completed basic checks. Reply with :thumbsup: to proceed to fanout. (approvers: jessie, sam, maria)

sam: :thumbsup:

jessie: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

alex: Proceeding to fanout in ~10m. Rollback playbook summary if abort: 1) re-pin manifest to previous stable (v1.4.1), 2) revoke sealed bundle and rollout pin, 3) send customer notice + support-runbook update.

jessie: Release notes updated: https://docs.internal/releases/1.4.2/zipstream-notes.md — added mirror validation steps and rollback checklist. Also re-published signed-submanifest with new pin.

deploybot: [deploybot] Fanout started at 03:22 UTC. Progress: 12/120 nodes replicated. ETA ~5m.

sam: 03:24 UTC — mirror verify error: connection reset to mirror-3 during blob transfer. Retry code shows ECONNRESET. Holding fanout.

deploybot: [deploybot] Fanout paused by operator (sam) at 03:24:30 UTC. Reason: mirror transfer failures observed on mirror-3. Awaiting operator decision (abort/continue).

sam: I'm aborting fanout. Mirror retry attempts exhausted and we hit the rollback trigger (mirror-transfer-error). Initiating rollback to private-installer:v1.4.1 now.

deploybot: [deploybot] Fanout aborted and rollback initiated at 03:25:05 UTC. Rollback target: private-installer:v1.4.1. Actions: manifest re-pinned, revoked rc3 sealed bundle, started cleanup tasks.

jessie: Confirming rollback steps executed: manifest pin restored to v1.4.1, pkgs re-validated, checksums match previous stable.
maria: Incident created: ENG-INC-2026-03-05-zipstream-mirror (initial triage doc): https://eng/incidents/ENG-INC-2026-03-05-zipstream-mirror.json

alex: Thanks team. We're deferring public rollout until mirrors are fully validated. Postmortem scheduled 2026-03-05 09:00 UTC. Action items: comprehensive mirror stress test, retry/backoff tuning for mirror-3, and add explicit mirror-health gating in deploybot. :slightly_smiling_face:
